sources.title: Introducing Amazon Nova: A New Generation of Foundation Models
sources.evidence: Dated December 3, 2024; explicitly says Nova Micro, Lite and Pro are generally available today. Identifies Amazon, the Nova family, multimodal Lite, and 300K context.

sources.title: Nova Lite - Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Exact model amazon.nova-lite-v1:0; 300K context; text/image/video input, text output, client-side tool calling. Lists launch as December 5, 2024, conflicting with the contemporaneous December 3 public GA announcement.

sources.title: What is Amazon Nova? - Version 1
sources.evidence: Names Amazon Nova Lite, model ID amazon.nova-lite-v1:0, 300K context, text/image/video input, text output, and PDF document support. Describes fast, low-cost multimodal processing and agentic use cases.

sources.title: The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card
sources.evidence: Section 1.1 explicitly states Pro, Lite and Micro are based on Transformer architecture. Model evaluations and tables do not disclose Lite total/active parameters or dense versus MoE topology. Author report accessed in HTML after the Amazon Science PDF exceeded the web fetch size limit.

sources.title: Amazon Nova Micro, Lite, Pro, and Premier - AWS AI Service Cards
sources.evidence: Service card covering models current April 30, 2025 identifies Nova family, Lite modalities and Transformer-based token inference. Does not disclose total/active parameter counts or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: Amazon Nova Premier: Technical Report and Model Card
sources.evidence: April 30, 2025 addendum discusses Lite as a distillation student. Its benchmark/runtime comparisons do not provide Lite total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Amazon Nova 2: Multimodal Reasoning and Generation Models
sources.evidence: Later report includes Nova 1 Lite rows in comparison Tables 1-3, reporting capability benchmarks rather than parameter counts. It does not disclose Nova 1 Lite total/active parameters or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: Customize Amazon Nova in Amazon SageMaker AI
sources.evidence: July 16, 2025 announcement explicitly classifies the model family as proprietary and names Nova Micro, Nova Lite and Nova Pro in the customization scope.

sources.title: Available foundation models - Amazon SageMaker AI
sources.evidence: Table dated July 29, 2026 lists Nova Lite, nova-textgeneration-lite, with license AWS Service Terms and inference instances not applicable. The row sits under the broad Open-Weight Models tab, conflicting with AWS explicit proprietary-weight statements; table placement alone is not treated as a weight-release announcement.

sources.title: Iterative Training - Amazon Nova
sources.evidence: Current documentation explicitly states Amazon Nova weights are proprietary and customized checkpoints remain in escrow S3 buckets in AWS-managed accounts instead of being copied to the customer account. Examples use Nova 2, so the exact Nova 1 Lite classification is anchored in the July 2025 announcement.

sources.title: Migrate from Amazon Nova 1 to Amazon Nova 2 on Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Exact comparison table lists Nova 1 Lite with 300K context and Extended Thinking No; Nova 2 Lite has Extended Thinking Yes. Describes the upgrade as adding extended thinking and preserves document-input support.

sources.title: Complete request schema - Amazon Nova
sources.evidence: Current version-1 guide includes reasoningConfig and explicitly labels it Amazon Nova Pro and Amazon Nova Lite only. This conflicts with the model-specific migration table; cannot establish a reliable current reasoning boolean from these sources.

sources.title: Models.dev Nova Lite record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead inspected and its AWS links followed; not used as independent primary verification.

name.note: Official model name; Amazon branding is already represented by the developer field.

developer.note: Developed by Amazon; technical report credits Amazon Artificial General Intelligence.

family.note: Normalized family key for Amazon Nova. Lite is the model tier; baseline nova-lite splits the documented Nova family.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public general availability announcement is December 3. Current Bedrock card lists December 5 without explaining the difference; do not replace the contemporaneous public release with that later listing date.

open_weights.note: AWS explicitly calls the family including Lite proprietary; current training documentation also says Nova weights remain proprietary. SageMaker broad table placement under Open-Weight Models is inconsistent, and is not evidence of a downloadable weight release.

license.note: Exact Nova Lite listing names AWS Service Terms. This is proprietary service usage licensing, not an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No Lite total parameter count is disclosed in the reviewed original report, April 2025 service card/Premier addendum, or later Nova 2 comparison tables. No model-size inference from hardware, pricing, or sibling names.

active_parameters_b.note: No Lite active-per-token parameter count is disclosed in those sources. Dense/MoE topology is not established, and active parameters are not equated with an unknown total.

architecture.note: Transformer is explicit. Dense versus mixture-of-experts topology and detailed configuration remain undisclosed; this value makes no sparsity claim.

context_window.note: 300K tokens in the exact v1 Lite column, confirmed by the migration comparison.

modalities.note: Text/image/video are native listed inputs; PDF is supported as document input through Converse. Text is the output modality; no audio input is asserted from the shared schema.

reasoning.note: Meaning is dedicated extended thinking, not general problem-solving capability. Exact Nova 1 Lite migration table says No, but the current v1 request schema explicitly documents reasoningConfig for Lite. Clear the baseline false pending resolution of this first-party contradiction.

tool_call.note: Exact Bedrock model card supports client-side tool calling; original report evaluates Lite function calling. Nova 2 built-in tools are a separate capability.

description.value: Nova model with text, image, video and PDF input, text output, a 300K-token context and tool calling.
description.note: Summary of documented inputs, output, context and tool calling without speed or price claims.

patch.description: Nova model with text, image, video and PDF input, text output, a 300K-token context and tool calling.
patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts are undisclosed in reviewed first-party reports; Transformer architecture is confirmed, but dense versus MoE topology is not. Public GA was December 3, 2024, despite the current Bedrock card listing December 5. Dedicated reasoning remains unresolved: the AWS migration table says Nova 1 Lite has no extended thinking, while the v1 API schema documents reasoningConfig for Lite. AWS explicitly classifies Nova as proprietary; inconsistent SageMaker table grouping is recorded in the audit.

summary: Confirmed the December 3, 2024 public launch, proprietary classification, 300K context, multimodal/PDF input and tool calling. Corrected family to nova, supplied AWS Service Terms and Transformer architecture, and made the description concrete. Total/active parameters and dense/MoE topology remain undisclosed after checking original and later first-party reports. Reasoning cleared to null because current AWS sources conflict; release-date and SageMaker classification-table inconsistencies are documented.
